description: Scan completed Gmail periods for receipts. In eligible split-tax-year accounts, a number is the period's ending year (2025 = 2024–25 tax year); otherwise it is a calendar year. Use returned tax-period labels and inclusive ISO bounds. Long-running: the first eligible period starts immediately; the rest queue one at a time (each full period typically takes hours; the app may close). Preview without confirmStart (no scan starts), ask the user to confirm, then start with confirmStart:true. For recent receipts (~60 days), use scan_gmail. The in-progress period cannot be year-scanned; use get_scan_status for progress.

accountEmail.description: Optional: which connected Gmail inbox to scan (multi-inbox users). Defaults to the primary.

confirmStart.description: Omit or false = preview only (no scan starts). Must be exactly true to start scanning.

years.description: Completed periods; ending year for eligible tax-year accounts (2025 = 2024–25), calendar year otherwise. Max 10.

name: scan_gmail_years
